{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
